text: The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit southbound left turn movements with the exception of Toronto Transit Commission buses, from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday. The proposed prohibition is the result of consultation with the local ward Councillor. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a bus service on Scarlett Road and Foxwell Street, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit southbound left turn movements from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays (buses and bicycles excepted) at the intersection of Scarlett Road and Foxwell Street. 2. City Council amend the existing southbound left turn prohibition from Scarlett Road to Foxwell Street from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, to exclude bicycles.
